description_en: A curved oval woven pouch fitted to a leather waist belt with textile zipper liner. Canonical front: a broad curved woven face and top zipper seam. Side view: a tapered wedge gusset matching the hip. Rear view: the padded leather belt backing and buckle straps. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: A curved oval woven pouch fitted to a leather waist belt with textile zipper liner. Canonical front: a broad curved woven face and top zipper seam. Side view: a tapered wedge gusset matching the hip. Rear view: the padded leather belt backing and buckle straps. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.. Style Zen: calm minimal ornament and simple proportions. Relative size compact within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: plain over-one-under-one basket weave. Finish: cinnabar red lacquer retaining clearly visible woven strip intersections. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, level with product center. No three-quarter or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
